C0836.title: Beijing Chaoyang Education Company Fined for Data Breach: Unencrypted System Testing
C0836.summary: In January 2024, an education company in Beijing's Chaoyang District was penalized for a data security violation. During the internet testing phase of its system development, the company failed to encrypt relevant data and did not implement security protection measures, constituting a failure to fulfill data security protection obligations.
